author: GamingBolt
description:
If you haven't heard, Crimson Desert is a beast of a game. Overwhelming at the start and absolutely massive in scale, it can take some time to learn all the ins and outs of everything. As fun as that can be, it doesn't hurt to have a few shortcuts in the opening hours. 

Here are 15 early game tips that will surely make life easier.
title: Crimson Desert - 15 Early Tips And Tricks You NEED To Keep In Mind

author: GamingBolt
description:
All in all, Death Stranding 2: On the Beach continues to be a phenomenal game that is easy to recommend to anyone regardless of their preferred platform. 

It offers a uniquely meditative experience for most of its runtime, punctuated by high-octane action thanks to its awesome boss fights, as well as emotional and epic moments alike with its fun story that revolves around whether or not connecting the world in the first game was altogether such a great idea.
title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach PC Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Pragmata is quite a fascinating game, aside from being a visual treat. The RE Engine is being put to good use in this game that's been a long time coming. Its story is quite an interesting look at generative AI gone wrong, while its cast and gameplay loop are bringing life to an experience that's quite captivating. 

We've been very curious about this one and with its recent showcase and a playable demo, we found a lot to like about it. There's a lot of layers to the game’s combat, and some features that the demo doesn't cover to find out more about. If you're thinking of diving in, this one's for you.
title: Pragmata - 15 Things You NEED TO KNOW Before You Buy
